stem:
Gauri scores $14$ marks out of $20$ on one test and $18$ marks out of $25$ on another.

Which claim about comparing her percentages is correct?

options.text: $18 > 14$, so the second score is the higher percentage.
A fair percentage comparison is what forces the totals $20$ and $25$ to be equal.
Write $14/20 = 70\%$ and $18/25 = 72\%$; the wholes differ, so compare those percentages rather than the raw marks alone.
Compare the raw marks $18$ and $14$ directly while the totals stay $25$ and $20$.

teacher.key_rationale: Different wholes require percentages: 70% vs 72%. Comparing raw marks, reversing what fair comparison requires, or claiming raw marks suffice when wholes differ miss that.
